lesson: Never open a long position without a predefined stop loss, even on high‑conviction ideas.
Validate trailing‑stop parameters before sending the order to avoid premature exits.
Avoid long entries on overbought symbols in a risk‑off regime unless a strong catalyst justifies it.
Avoid opening‑range breakout entries when relative volume is high but price is already losing momentum; require VWAP confirmation before entry.
Tighten stop distances on low‑volume or flat‑trend stocks and use tighter trailing stops for mean‑reversion plays.
Do not re‑enter the same ticker after an early manager‑sell unless a new catalyst emerges.
